title: Calculating the Temporary Credit on a Personal Checking Claim
content:
The temporary credit is the claimed total taken at the credited share and rounded half-up to the cent, with the charge offset added to it.

**The claimed total** is every foreign card item posted to the Personal Checking account, whenever it posted.

**The credited share** is half, that is a share of 0.5, of the claimed total.

**The charge offset.** No charge offset is added.

The temporary credit is taken in whole steps of 5.00, rounded half-up.

**Worked example on hypothetical inputs.** An account carries foreign card items of 200.00, 120.00 and 3.00.

| Quantity | Hypothetical figure |
|---|---|
| Claimed total | 323.00 |
| Claimed total taken at the credited share, rounded half-up to the cent | 161.50 |
| Charge offset added | 0.00 |
| Figure before the final rounding | 161.50 |
| Temporary credit, in whole steps of 5.00, rounded half-up | 160.00 |

The rounding to the cent falls on the claimed total taken at the credited share, before the charge offset is added; the final rounding to whole steps of 5.00 falls on the two together.
